item.title: OpenAI Launches Codex Plugin for Claude Code: Letting Codex Do Code Reviews from Inside Enemy Territory
item.description: OpenAI released the Codex Plugin for Claude Code, letting you call Codex directly from within Claude Code for cross-model code reviews. This article covers the three core commands, installation steps, and design philosophy backed by official documentation.

item.title: I Put My Entire Life Into a Database: 3.8 Million Rows of Quantified Self Data
item.description: Felix Krause spent three years tracking 380,000 life data points - from mood to weather, exercise to coffee intake - all stored in a Postgres database. This isn't geek OCD; it's a hardcore experiment in self-knowledge.

item.title: Locking Down Your Local AI Agent: An Agent Safehouse Review
item.description: A macOS tool that sandboxes AI agents like Claude Code and Codex, preventing accidental file deletions and credential leaks once and for all.

item.title: Someone Tested Claude Code 2,430 Times and Discovered Its Tool Selection Logic Isn't What You'd Expect
item.description: Amplifying.ai ran 2,430 tests on Claude Code and found that in 12 out of 20 categories, it prefers writing custom code over using existing tools. GitHub Actions 94%, Stripe 91%, shadcn/ui 90% selection rates are striking, while AWS, GCP, and Azure got zero primary picks.

item.title: Codex CLI Ships 12 Versions in 20 Days: Features That Doubled My Coding Productivity
item.description: From v0.86 to v0.97, how did OpenAI's AI coding assistant transform? This article walks you through the most practical new features across these 12 versions—see which productivity boosters you've been missing.

item.title: Claude Code Tamagotchi: Your VSCode Coding Pet and AI Buddy
item.description: Turn coding into a nurturing game: Claude Code Tamagotchi lives in your VSCode status bar, reacts to your real coding activity, and offers gentle reminders and companionship. Includes a 3‑minute setup (npm/bun), local save, and CLI interactions.

item.title: Stop Copy-Pasting: Cursor CLI Puts an AI Coding Agent Right in Your Terminal
item.description: Say goodbye to constant context switching between browser and terminal. Cursor CLI injects a powerful AI Agent into your command line for chat-style code generation, file operations, code reviews, and CI/CD automation—keeping you in flow whether you're on SSH, Vim/Neovim, local, or remote.
